notes.general_comments:
There were many excellent scripts, but also some low-scoring scripts. Candidates often struggled to provide
a reasonable depth of thought on their offerings to the last question and the required handling of radian
measure was disappointing. The standard of presentation was good from the majority of candidates, though
it must be mentioned again that dividing the paper into two halves and working down both sides is a practice
not to be encouraged.
